verdict.rationale: Empresa Online is a government online company-incorporation service, and a built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature for such a portal, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an AI assistant or any way to delegate tasks to one. The automatic generation of the pacto social from form data is template-driven document assembly, not an AI assistant, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
